We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Account Executive (Polish-speaking) (m/f/d) Your Role

As an Account Executive at fonio, you're a closer through and through. You get warm, pre-qualified leads every day and know exactly what to do with them. And when the pipeline dries out, you don't wait around: you go on the hunt for deals.

What to expect

 * Inbound demos: 8-16 qualified demo calls per day

 * Quota ownership: clear monthly and quarterly targets

 * Pipeline management: structured follow-ups and clean CRM hygiene

 * Help sharpen our sales motion as we scale fast

Who We're Looking For

 * 1+ years of sales experience in transactional or B2B SaaS sales

 * Proven closing track record along a structured funnel

 * High discipline, strong ownership, and a genuine hunger to earn

 * Natural communicator and storyteller

 * Native or C2 Polish; strong English. German is a big plus

 * Ready for a paid temporary relocation (around 2 months in Vienna to soak up our culture)

What We Offer

 * €65.000-€80.000 OTE (base + uncapped commission)

 * Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it.

 * Unlimited budget with the right ROI

 * Relocation bonus (in case you want to stay in Vienna)

 * Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy

 * Regular team offsites

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 45 min skill interview with our CCO Alex, including a demo simulation

 * 30 min chat to get to know the go-to-market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities). Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. jobs.description: 1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing. * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz. * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies. * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences. * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense. * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging.
